    return [list(row) for row in zip(*g[::-1])]

def _rot_ccw(g):
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*g)][::-1]

def _rot_180(g):
    return [row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    tiles = (grid, _rot_cw(grid), _rot_ccw(grid), _rot_180(grid))
    out = [[0] * (2*n) for _ in range(2*n)]

        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                out[qr*n+i][qc*n+j] = int(tile[i][j])
    return out
